page.title: Smart allocation
page.description: New reservations receive a compatible room when created. The engine can suggest changes to improve occupancy, but existing reservations stay in their rooms until Reception approves a proposal.
page.reviewBeforeApply: Initial assignment is automatic · future changes need approval
page.actionFailed: The operation could not be completed: {{message}}
page.genericFailure: The operation could not be completed.
page.staleProposal: Reservations changed after this calculation. The proposal was not applied. Reject it and generate a new proposal to review the current state.

policy.title: Allocation objective
policy.description: Room allocation arranges future reservations to improve continuous occupancy by room.

objectives.occupiedNights: Reduce gaps and maximize occupied nights by room

policy.assignmentObjectiveNote: Room allocation does not change rates. Price recommendations are reviewed and approved separately.
policy.legacyObjectiveNormalized: The historical version requested {{objective}} priority. It remains in history; current runs prioritize occupancy and continuity.

proposal.title: Latest proposal
proposal.description: Recalculation prepares suggestions for review. No existing reservation changes rooms until an authorized person accepts the proposal.
proposal.recalculateHelp: The engine proposes complete changes. Review and accept them to move reservations; checked-in guests stay in place.
proposal.resolveBeforeRecalculate: Accept or reject the pending proposal before generating another.
proposal.empty: There are no runs yet. Recalculate to optimize current assignments.
proposal.noAssignments: This calculation did not produce room assignments.

reasons.optimizesRoomUse: Rearranges rooms to make better use of inventory
reasons.returningGuest: Keeps a room used during a previous stay
reasons.noDetails: The engine did not provide an additional reason

proposal.acceptRequiresSuccess: This calculation did not complete successfully. You can reject its proposal, but cannot apply it.
proposal.confirmAccept: Confirming will move the {{count}} proposed reservations. Continue?
proposal.confirmAcceptLocked: The PMS will apply {{count}} moves: you authorize {{approvedCount}} protected move(s) once, and {{preservedCount}} will remain unapplied. Locks stay active. Confirm?
proposal.confirmAcceptWithLockedLeft: The PMS will apply {{count}} eligible moves. {{preservedCount}} protected moves will remain unapplied with their locks active. Confirm?
proposal.confirmReject: Confirming will discard the {{count}} suggestions and keep current rooms. Continue?
proposal.approveLockedMoveOnce: Authorize this move once; keep the lock for future runs
proposal.lockedMoveLeftUnchanged: This move was not authorized. The reservation stays in its current room and remains locked.
proposal.lockedMoveApprovedOnce: Move authorized once. The lock remains active for future runs.
proposal.lockedMovesRemain: Protected moves without approval were left unapplied and remain locked.
proposal.reviewed: There are no pending moves in this proposal.
proposal.suggestionsPendingReview: The engine found {{count}} suggested change(s). No reservations were moved; Reception must approve them.
proposal.noSuggestedMoves: There are no suggested changes. Current rooms stay as assigned.

locks.title: Protected reservations
locks.description: Protect a room when it must stay with a reservation. A proposed move requires one-time approval and keeps the lock active.
locks.readPermissionRequired: Your role cannot view reservations. You can review proposals, but cannot manage protected reservations.
locks.empty: There are no upcoming reservations to show.
locks.lockNotAvailable: Only an assigned reservation before check-in can be protected.
